screens.headline: كل ما يخص وحدتك في مكان واحد
screens.subtitle: تابع وحدتك ومستحقاتك وطلبات الصيانة بسهولة.
screens.art: Bright, welcoming opener: two concentric gold arches spring from the lower-left margin, a small gold window lattice sits in the left margin, and a wide, low-alpha gold wash warms the top-left corner. Navy headline, petrol subtitle, purple kicker rule.

screens.headline: تابع مستحقاتك بكل سهولة
screens.subtitle: اطّلع على المستحقات والمدفوعات السابقة في أي وقت.
screens.art: Payments: a right-aligned column of statement rules of uneven length (gold and petrol) reads as a dues ledger, scored by a vertical spine and five gold ticks in the right margin. Cool petrol wash, purple kicker rule.

screens.variant: payment — code card, authentic Fawry accent
screens.headline: ادفع مستحقاتك عبر فوري
screens.subtitle: احصل على كود الدفع وسدّد مستحقاتك بسهولة.
screens.art: Payment focus: a gold code-card outline with two inner rules and dotted keylines in both margins. The only yellow in the campaign is the authentic Fawry yellow #FFDD00 sampled from this screen's own source screenshot, used as the 96x6 kicker rule above the headline and one 184px footer hairline - no other yellow branding.

screens.headline: تصاريح ذكية لزوارك
screens.subtitle: أنشئ تصاريح الزيارة وشاركها باستخدام رمز QR.
screens.art: Visitor entry: a gold gate portal with three bars and a petrol access frame, plus mirrored post markers down both margins and a threshold hairline just above the device. Light, open composition - entry is granted, not blocked.

screens.headline: صيانة أسهل، ومتابعة أوضح
screens.subtitle: قدّم طلبات الصيانة وتابع مراحل تنفيذها.
screens.art: Technical maintenance: a petrol dimension line with end ticks and four station ticks, a small gold keyframe, two ruled margin traces with cross ticks, and a 72px 45-degree hatch band along the base - a drafting sheet, not a dashboard.

screens.headline: مهامك اليومية بين يديك
screens.subtitle: نظّم أعمال الصيانة وتابع المهام المكلّف بها.
screens.art: Technician workflow: three gold task-node outlines chained by elbow connectors down the left edge, mirrored by an eight-point petrol task queue in the right margin. A restrained purple wash in the top-right corner ties it to the purple kicker rule.

screens.headline: دخول منظّم وآمن
screens.subtitle: تحقّق من تصاريح الزوار بسرعة عبر مسح رمز QR.
screens.art: Dark security: the source screen is itself dark navy, so the canvas goes near-black #042434 fading to #07425D and the device reads as a lighter #07425D shell. Gold scan brackets sit at all four canvas corners in echo of the scanner frame inside the screenshot, with three gold radar arcs bottom-right and a dotted petrol trust line.

screens.headline: إدارة عقارية برؤية شاملة
screens.subtitle: تابع التحصيلات والصيانة والعمليات من مكان واحد.
screens.art: Executive oversight: a gold-hairline skyline silhouette rises from the base behind and beside the device (visible in the margins and the 72px footer strip), and a three-rule hierarchy sits top-left. Deep #042434 to #07425D gradient with a soft petrol glow - the calm, widest-view close.
